name: EOAT Project Setup Tool
description: Existing setup script that creates the initial EOAT project folder and master tracker when safe.
input: Toolkit root and optional command-line arguments
output: Project folder, workbook, README, and baseline schedule files

name: Daily Status Summary Generator
description: Existing daily reporting script with manual notes, Git-aware reporting, snapshots, and schedule tracking.
input: Project root, day/week inputs, optional manual notes
output: Daily Markdown/DOCX reports and activity summary JSON

name: Foundation Validation Tool
description: Read-only project foundation validation that writes a Markdown report and logs the run.
input: EOAT project root
output: ToolResult, activity log entry, and Markdown validation report

name: EOAT Audit Form Tool
description: Structured entry form for collecting EOAT audit data and appending it safely to the master workbook.
input: Cell, robot, EOAT, sensor, pneumatic, issue, and photo fields
output: New EOAT Inventory rows and optional action items

name: EOAT Photo Intake and Renaming Tool
description: Imports, renames, indexes, and links EOAT photos using a consistent naming convention.
input: Incoming photo folder and cell/audit metadata
output: Organized photos and Photo Index rows

name: EOAT Workbook Validator
description: Validates workbook sheets, headers, data completeness, IDs, links, and field consistency.
input: Master workbook
output: Validation report and warning list

name: Weekly Summary Generator
description: Builds weekly progress summaries from daily reports, activity logs, task progress, and workbook signals.
input: Daily reports and activity data
output: Weekly Markdown/DOCX status report

name: Issue Analysis Tool
description: Analyzes Issue Log trends, top problem cells, missing risk data, and FMEA candidate failure modes.
input: Issue Log, EOAT Inventory, Interview Notes, and Pilot Candidates
output: Issue analysis metrics and Markdown report

name: KPI Dashboard Builder
description: Summarizes downtime, drops, mis-picks, scrap, maintenance events, and cycle-time signals.
input: KPI Baseline workbook sheet and optional raw KPI files
output: KPI charts and dashboard-ready report sections

name: FMEA-Lite Builder
description: Helps build and score practical EOAT FMEA-lite entries from observed issues.
input: Issue Log and audit observations
output: FMEA Draft rows and risk summaries

name: Pilot Candidate Ranking Tool
description: Scores candidate EOAT cells by impact, feasibility, safety, quality, and available evidence.
input: Pilot Candidates, Issue Log, and KPI Baseline data
output: Ranked candidate list and scoring explanation

name: EOAT PM Checklist Generator
description: Generates preventive maintenance checklist drafts by EOAT type and common failure modes.
input: EOAT type, maintenance concerns, and standards templates
output: Checklist document drafts

name: BOM and Spare Parts Standardization Tool
description: Organizes common EOAT parts, spare components, and BOM standardization opportunities.
input: Audit rows, BOM notes, and spare part observations
output: BOM/spares standardization tables

name: EOAT Documentation Gap Scanner
description: Finds missing drawings, BOMs, photos, process binder links, and maintenance references.
input: Workbook documentation fields and project folders
output: Gap list and follow-up actions

name: EOAT Audit Progress Dashboard Tool
description: Shows audited cells, open follow-ups, issue counts, photo coverage, and Week 1-3 progress.
input: Master workbook and task progress files
output: Dashboard cards and progress charts

name: Mentor Meeting Prep Tool
description: Builds a concise meeting prep view with progress, blockers, decisions needed, and next actions.
input: Daily reports, task progress, action items, and manual notes
output: Meeting prep Markdown/DOCX draft

name: Operator/Technician Interview Form Tool
description: Captures structured interview notes and links them to cells, issues, and audit records.
input: Interview responses and cell metadata
output: Interview Notes rows and optional issue/action rows

name: Daily What Should I Work On? Morning Planner
description: Recommends the day's priorities from project schedule, task progress, blockers, and open actions.
input: Schedule, task progress, action items, and manual constraints
output: Daily work plan and focus list

name: Final Presentation Builder Helper
description: Assembles evidence, KPIs, pilot results, photos, and recommendations for the final presentation.
input: Final report materials, KPI outputs, and pilot documentation
output: Presentation outline and slide content checklist

name: Final Deliverable Checker
description: Checks whether final EOAT project deliverables are found, missing, partial, or need review.
input: Project folders, workbook sheets, and generated report locations
output: Deliverable status report and missing-deliverables list

name: Final Project Summary Compiler
description: Compiles an evidence-based final project summary draft from workbook metrics and generated reports.
input: Workbook metrics, weekly summaries, analysis reports, PM/BOM outputs, and optional notes
output: Markdown and optional DOCX final summary draft

name: Final Handoff Builder
description: Packages final workbook, standards, checklists, training materials, reports, and presentation files.
input: Completed project deliverables
output: Final handoff package index and folder checklist

name: Full System Audit
description: Checks toolkit, dependencies, registry, CLI scripts, config, project folders, workbook, activity logs, and report folders.
input: Toolkit root and EOAT project root
output: System audit Markdown report and ToolResult

name: Workflow Runner
description: Runs safe daily, weekly, and final review workflows across existing report tools.
input: Project root, workflow name, week/day
output: Combined workflow report and ToolResult

name: Project Backup Tool
description: Creates timestamped workbook, config, report-index, or light project backups without deleting originals.
input: Project root and backup mode
output: Backup files or zip plus ToolResult
